نفترض (form VIII)
# نَفْتَرِضُ (naftariḍu) /naf.ta.ri.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# نُفْتَرَضُ (nuftaraḍu) /nuf.ta.ra.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# نَفْتَرِضَ (naftariḍa) /naf.ta.ri.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# نُفْتَرَضَ (nuftaraḍa) /nuf.ta.ra.dˤ
